source.title: Therapy contract-payment platform build plan, Rules reference tab as of 2026-10-14 (copy of docs/product/rules-reference.md)
source.locator: Therapy-specific Medicare rules table, row "Assistant modifiers CQ and CO" (line 22)

questions: The second pass was typed by the same build session as the first, so it is not an independent transcription: a second person redoes records.second-pass.json from the stored primary source (the checker refuses L2 while both passes name the same transcriber).

Open the CMS therapy services page (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services): are services with the CQ modifier paid at 85% of the otherwise applicable amount, effective January 1, 2022?
Store that CMS page (or the final rule that set the reduction) under content/sources/assistant_modifier/ and re-cite this record to it, quoting the stored file.
Has CMS changed the percentage since 2022? The window is open-ended.

quotes: Paid at 85% of the otherwise applicable amount, effective January 1, 2022
notes: Hand-typed from the plan's rules reference, which cites CMS therapy services (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/therapy-services). Applied only when the rate record's apply_assistant_reduction flag is on.
